latest_earnings_cash_test.status: Focused Intel earnings-to-cash test completed. Earnings upside identified; LONG not established.

root_decision.working_operating_thesis: Intel’s richer CPU mix could deliver earnings above published forecasts without a major new external wafer customer. The investment question is how much cash Intel must reinvest to deliver those earnings.
root_decision.earnings_result: The existing operating forecast produces conditional adjusted EPS proxies of about $2.50 in 2027 and $4.17 in 2028. The premium survives several tax, accounting-presentation and Foundry-cost controls. It is not solely an EBIT-versus-EPS comparison error.
root_decision.investment_result: No LONG recommendation established. These operating earnings already underpin the existing cash valuation; expressing them as adjusted EPS does not increase cash value. A higher P/E alone cannot resolve the economic disagreement.
root_decision.why_the_edge_is_narrower_than_the_EPS_ga: The matched 2027 DCAI growth difference explains only about 30% of the EPS gap to iFAST under our other conventions. The entire premium cannot be presented as one overlooked CPU pricing effect.
root_decision.capital_review: No demonstrated double counting of physical capital or justified asset-light cash uplift. Intel Products uses internal manufacturing and external suppliers; the custom-silicon manufacturing split is insufficiently disclosed to remove host capital spending.
root_decision.prior_short: The prior early-repricing SHORT remains withdrawn as the preferred submission. This test does not revive it.
root_decision.submission_status: The old PDF remains a superseded discussion draft. No current directional submission is endorsed; nothing was submitted.

latest_direction_resolution.status: Completed substantive direction review and three-page working pitch. Qualified valuation SHORT selected as current candidate; no proven trading alpha or winning probability.

root_decision.working_recommendation: SHORT, qualified valuation thesis for competition review
root_decision.thesis: Intel can recover operationally while its equity offers insufficient compensation for manufacturing and cyclical risk at the entry price. The existing funded forecast supports a lower end-2026 planning value than the dated quote.
root_decision.fair_value_date: 2026-12-31 planning reference, not a 2030 target or predicted price-convergence date
root_decision.why_direction_selected_now: A fundamental valuation opinion can be a legitimate directional competition candidate without exact consensus, a guaranteed catalyst or positive price-only unhedged short PnL in every future year. Our higher operating-risk allowance supports the bearish stance; that remains a judgment rather than proven mispricing.
root_decision.limits_on_selection: Risk-adjusted underperformance has not been established by a specified hedged trade. No counter-long, hedge ratio, broker borrow/carry, margin return or portfolio alpha is modeled. Do not subtract the operating discount rate from shareholder CAGR and label the difference alpha.
root_decision.primary_counterargument: The central 2030 value is $67.58, above the $58.28 entry, implying 3.63% annual long price appreciation and a $9.30 price-only short loss before carry. Risk maturation raises the conditional 2030 value to $76.86 and long price CAGR to 6.89%.
root_decision.risk_sensitivity: At 10% operating discount, unchanged central cash supports $60.09 at end-2026; the dated quote matches about 10.17846%. The short view is materially exposed to the risk assumption.
